criteria.title: Apply address, undefined-behavior, thread, and memory-initialization checks where supported.

security.scope: Bounded original teaching defect, model or learner-owned component only.
security.target: The original local component/model specified in this criterion; synthetic counters, buffers and input only.
security.environment: Host process with the declared diagnostic runtime; stack-overrun/MPU examples remain bounded byte-array models unless a separately authorized dedicated board contract applies.
security.attacker_capabilities: Controls the specified bounded input, logical operation order or deliberate defect mutation; no authority over host policy or unrelated processes.
security.isolation: Run deliberate memory/race defects in an isolated short-lived local process with bounded resources. No external targets, real data, invalid native return address execution or changes to host protections.
security.defect: ASan checks all uninitialized values and TSan proves race freedom.
security.exposing_transition: Use isolated original defect programs for heap overrun, use-after-free, uninitialized branch and a shared counter race. Run separate supported ASan/UBSan, Memcheck and TSan profiles with repaired controls.

security.success_condition: Actual diagnostic mechanism and explored-path limits are recorded; unsupported profiles remain incomplete.
security.repair: Identify and repair the precise violated extent, lifetime, initialization, synchronization or authority invariant. Preserve a corrected control and reproduce the original discriminating condition.
security.regression: Check the corrected result/state and ensure the deliberate defect still fails for its intended semantic cause. Actual diagnostic mechanism and explored-path limits are recorded; unsupported profiles remain incomplete.
security.residual_limits: Tool and model coverage are bounded; unsupported instrumented profiles and physical protection claims remain explicit gaps.
